widgets_values: A single continuous cinematic 10-second LTX-2.3 PromptRelay text-to-video shot of a modern Formula 1 car racing through a realistic night street circuit. Detailed carbon fiber bodywork, wet asphalt reflections, track lights, tire spray, heat shimmer, motion blur controlled by shutter realism, low aggressive camera angles, high-speed racing energy, no logos, no readable text, no extra cars unless clearly background silhouettes.

[0-2.5s] A low front-left tracking camera follows the Formula 1 car as it launches down the wet night straight, reflections streaking under the tires.

|
[2.5-5s] The camera slides toward the side as the car clips a corner apex, suspension compressing, tire spray and track lights stretching across the asphalt.

|
[5-7.5s] A tight rear-quarter shot shows the rear wing vibrating subtly while heat shimmer rises and the car accelerates out of the turn.

|
[7.5-10s] The camera pulls back into a clean hero shot as the car disappears down the illuminated street circuit, leaving a sharp trail of reflections and engine intensity.
